choices.explanation: This does not verify compatibility before the update is applied.

choices.text: Restore the previous day's database snapshot and assume that it contains the same data as the current update.
choices.explanation: This does not create a parallel environment that includes writes made after the snapshot's recovery point.

choices.text: Test only the green environment and assume that production has moved without performing a switch operation.
choices.explanation: Creating and testing an environment alone does not switch the connection target.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: RDS Blue/Green Deployments let you validate an update in a separate environment before switching over.
learning.concept: Check compatibility and replication status before performing the switchover.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Automatically pause Aurora during periods without access
prompt: You are using Aurora Serverless v2 with a supported engine and Region in a test environment. No connections or features that prevent automatic pausing are configured. What should you configure so that compute capacity can scale down to 0 during periods without use?

choices.text: Disable the reader's DNS cache.
choices.explanation: This does not specify the conditions for automatic pausing while idle.

choices.text: Set the backup retention period to 0.
choices.explanation: This does not configure the cluster's compute capacity to stop.

choices.text: Set the maximum capacity to 0 ACU and leave the minimum capacity unchanged.
choices.explanation: This is not a valid capacity configuration and does not specify automatic pausing.

choices.text: Set the minimum capacity to 0 ACU and configure the idle period required for pausing.
choices.explanation: With a supported configuration, this allows the cluster to pause when it is unused.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: For supported Aurora Serverless v2 configurations, setting the minimum capacity to 0 ACU enables automatic pausing.
learning.concept: Also verify the automatic resume delay and the requirements for connections that remain active.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Automatically transition infrequently accessed files
prompt: You have a Regional EFS file system in which old reports are accessed infrequently but must remain immediately available through the same NFS path. What should you use to change the storage class based on how long the files have not been accessed, without requiring users to move to another system?

choices.text: Change only the report paths from Regional to One Zone.
choices.explanation: This is not a feature that moves files within the same file system based on access frequency.

choices.text: Stop the NFS client cache and assume that the storage class will change automatically.
choices.explanation: A local client setting is not an EFS class-transition policy.

choices.text: Manually move all reports to S3 and make them available in the same way through the existing NFS paths.
choices.explanation: The same EFS paths cannot be maintained after moving the files to S3.

choices.text: Configure an EFS lifecycle policy to transition files to the appropriate IA storage class based on the period since last access.
choices.explanation: This changes the storage class while preserving the original file system and paths.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: EFS lifecycle management can automatically transition files between storage classes.
learning.concept: Changing a storage class is different from moving files to another system or deleting them.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Preparing an S3 Restore Destination for Auditing While Preserving Existing Data
prompt: Data is restored from an AWS Backup S3 recovery point to a separate bucket dedicated to auditing. The destination bucket is in a supported Region, and its encryption and access permissions can be configured according to policy. What S3 requirement must the destination meet?

choices.text: Assume the restore will work if versioning is suspended on the destination.
choices.explanation: This does not meet the prerequisites for an AWS Backup destination.

choices.text: Make the destination a public bucket.
choices.explanation: This is not an AWS Backup prerequisite, and there is no reason to expose audit data publicly.

choices.text: Delete all objects in the existing production bucket before starting.
choices.explanation: The restore uses a separate destination, so deleting the production bucket's current data is unnecessary.

choices.text: Enable S3 Versioning on the audit destination bucket.
choices.explanation: The destination bucket for an AWS Backup restore must have versioning enabled.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: An S3 destination bucket for an AWS Backup restore must have versioning enabled.
learning.concept: Using a separate restore destination separates the restore operation from the current production bucket.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Switching to a Standby Region While Keeping the S3 Client Endpoint
prompt: S3 buckets in supported Regions A and B are associated with the same Multi-Region Access Point, and the asynchronous replication status has been verified. Only A currently receives traffic. After the switch, new requests must be sent only to B while the application's MRAP endpoint remains unchanged. Which routing-state settings should be configured? Select two.

choices.text: Set the routing status of Region A to passive.
choices.explanation: After the switch, new requests will not be routed to A.

choices.text: Leave the routing status of Region A active.
choices.explanation: This conflicts with the requirement to use only B because A would also receive requests.

choices.text: Set the routing status of Region B to active.
choices.explanation: B can receive new requests through the existing endpoint.

choices.text: Start S3 Batch Replication to B through the replication rules.
choices.explanation: This copies objects; it does not configure where new requests are sent.

choices.text: Distribute Region B's bucket URL to the application as a new destination.
choices.explanation: This conflicts with the premise that the existing MRAP endpoint will continue to be used.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: MRAP failover controls switch traffic to the buckets.
learning.concept: The process that replicates data and the setting that determines where requests are sent are separate.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Requiring Strong Consistency Across Multiple Regions
prompt: A DynamoDB table is deployed in multiple Regions, and reads immediately after a regional switch must reflect completed updates. The required Region group and data model are available, and write synchronization latency is acceptable. Which mode should be used?

choices.text: Choose MRSC and configure either three replicas or two replicas and a witness in a supported Region group.
choices.explanation: This configuration provides strong consistency across Regions.

choices.text: Extend the DAX cache duration regardless of the mode.
choices.explanation: Extending the cache duration does not provide strong cross-Region consistency.

choices.text: Replicate with MREC and assume that a strong read in one Region will always return the latest updates from the other Region.
choices.explanation: MREC does not make asynchronous cross-Region replication synchronous.

choices.text: Create the table in only one Region and maintain network access to that Region after a failure.
choices.explanation: There would be no replica to switch to if the dependent Region failed.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: DynamoDB global tables let you choose a consistency mode across Regions.
learning.concept: When strong consistency is required, verify the supported Regions and placement constraints.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Distributing Existing Tasks Across Multiple AZs After Capacity Recovery
prompt: An ECS service that can run in three AZs became skewed toward another AZ when one AZ temporarily lacked capacity. All three AZs now have capacity, and existing tasks run normally with a compatible configuration. What should be configured so that the service can correct the task imbalance?

choices.text: Launch only additional tasks in the same AZ.
choices.explanation: This does not remove the existing imbalance.

choices.text: Change only the unit of the CPU metric.
choices.explanation: This does not change the distribution of tasks across AZs.

choices.text: Force-stop all tasks in the imbalanced AZ at the same time.
choices.explanation: This does not provide gradual distribution control while maintaining service operation.

choices.text: Enable Availability Zone rebalancing for the ECS service.
choices.explanation: The service can launch tasks in an underrepresented AZ and, as appropriate, stop tasks in an overrepresented AZ to rebalance them.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: ECS Availability Zone rebalancing can improve the distribution of tasks that are already running.
learning.concept: Distinguish a policy that only places new tasks from a policy that corrects an existing imbalance after recovery.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Meet the long-term retention requirement only at the copy destination
prompt: An AWS Backup policy retains the original recovery point for an EBS resource for 30 days. The corresponding recovery point copied to another Region must be retained for 365 days. You do not want to extend the original retention period or increase costs in both Regions. What should you configure?

choices.text: Include 365 in the name of the destination vault.
choices.explanation: A vault name does not configure the recovery point's retention period.

choices.text: Delete the destination recovery point immediately after the copy and use only the original 30-day recovery point.
choices.explanation: This does not meet the long-term retention requirement.

choices.text: Change only the original retention period to 365 days and do not configure retention for the destination.
choices.explanation: This does not meet the requirement to avoid increasing costs for the original recovery point and does not separate the retention objectives.

choices.text: Specify the destination vault and a 365-day retention period in the backup plan's copy action, while retaining the original for 30 days.
choices.explanation: This keeps the original recovery point unchanged while retaining the destination copy for a longer period.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A separate lifecycle can be specified for the recovery point at the copy destination.
learning.concept: A backup plan can express the retention requirements for the copy source and destination independently.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Limit the redrive rate when reprocessing quarantined messages after a fix
prompt: After fixing a failure, you need to move messages accumulated in an SQS DLQ back to the source queue. Because normal traffic is also arriving, you do not want to move all messages at once; an operator needs to limit the redrive rate at startup. Which operation should be used?

choices.text: Configure a DLQ redrive to the source destination and start with a low custom rate.
choices.explanation: This allows the messages to be reintroduced without placing a sudden load on the original processing system.

choices.text: Resend all normal application traffic and discard the DLQ.
choices.explanation: This does not safely reintroduce only the specified quarantined data.

choices.text: Only increase the source queue's MaxReceiveCount and assume that messages in the DLQ will move back automatically.
choices.explanation: This changes only the condition for moving messages out of the source queue and does not start a redrive from the DLQ.

choices.text: Shorten the DLQ retention period.
choices.explanation: The messages would expire and be lost instead of being reintroduced.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: DLQ redrive allows the message movement rate to be specified.
learning.concept: Estimate the redrive rate in relation to normal processing traffic.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: An index limits writes even though the table has capacity available
prompt: Some updates to a provisioned DynamoDB table are rejected. The table itself has sufficient write capacity, and the failure reason indicates IndexWriteProvisionedThroughputExceeded for a specific GSI. What should you review first?

choices.text: Back up the DynamoDB items to remove throttling.
choices.explanation: Backup configuration does not increase the processing capacity of an individual index.

choices.text: Change GSI reads to use strong consistency.
choices.explanation: GSIs do not support strong consistency, and the issue concerns write throttling in any case.

choices.text: Review the write capacity and Auto Scaling settings for the affected GSI and provide sufficient headroom.
choices.explanation: This addresses the index that is actually constrained by capacity.

choices.text: Increase only the read capacity of the source table.
choices.explanation: This does not change the affected GSI's write throttling.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Insufficient GSI write capacity can affect writes to the source table.
learning.concept: Review capacity according to the throttling reason, which identifies the affected resource and operation.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Quickly return a cluster to just before an accidental operation
prompt: An Aurora MySQL-compatible cluster was created with backtracking enabled. During testing, when all users had been stopped, an accidental operation occurred. You need to return the cluster itself to a point within the applicable backtrack window and continue without creating a new cluster or name. What should you use?

choices.text: Add a read replica and wait for the historical data to be restored automatically.
choices.explanation: Adding a replica to the current cluster does not return it to the state before the accidental operation.

choices.text: Perform only a standard point-in-time restore and assume that the same cluster will be overwritten.
choices.explanation: A standard PITR creates a new cluster.

choices.text: Change only the date in the snapshot metadata.
choices.explanation: This does not return the current database state to an earlier point in time.

choices.text: Use Backtrack to specify the target time, then verify the cluster after the operation.
choices.explanation: Backtrack can return the same cluster to a state within the available time range.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Aurora MySQL Backtrack can return the current cluster to an earlier point in time when the required configuration is enabled.
learning.concept: Check write activity on the cluster being restored and the available time range.

category: 信頼性と事業継続
examDomain: 信頼性と事業継続
title: Test a new function version with a portion of invocations
prompt: The Lambda callers use a production alias. The old and new versions meet weighted-routing requirements, such as using the same execution role. You want to send about 5% of traffic to the new version through a configuration change and, if problems occur, return to only the original version without changing the callers. What should you configure?

choices.text: Delete the old version, migrate to the new version, and upload the old version again after a problem occurs.
choices.explanation: There is no retained version to return to immediately.

choices.text: Set an additional weight of 0.05 for the new version on an alias whose primary version is the old version.
choices.explanation: Removing the additional weight during an incident returns delivery to only the old version.

choices.text: Only pass 5 to an environment variable in the new version.
choices.explanation: This does not affect the invocation ratio for the alias target.

choices.text: Switch the callers to the unqualified function ARN so that they always use the latest version.
choices.explanation: This does not create a configuration that tests the new version at a fixed percentage while retaining the old version.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A function alias can route traffic to two published versions using weights.
learning.concept: Separate observing success from changing the alias routing ratio.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Continue processing after an asynchronous operation completes
prompt: An SSM Automation runbook requests that an EC2 instance start. The API returns after accepting the request, so the next operation must run only after the state becomes running. What should you add to avoid waiting the same number of seconds every time?

choices.text: Run the subsequent operation immediately after the API succeeds.
choices.explanation: The actual startup might not have finished.

choices.text: Wait with aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty until the result of DescribeInstances becomes running.
choices.explanation: This verifies the actual startup state before proceeding to the subsequent operation.

choices.text: Record that the API accepted the request and remove all state checks.
choices.explanation: This does not verify the condition that the resource is ready.

choices.text: Add a fixed 30-second wait for every instance.
choices.explanation: The workflow could proceed even when this startup takes longer than 30 seconds.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: You can poll a resource's state and wait for the desired state.
learning.concept: Distinguish API request acceptance from resource readiness.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Use the same maintenance procedure from multiple runbooks
prompt: Several SSM Automation runbooks use the same approved procedure. Each caller has the input for the maintenance target, and the caller must continue after the internal procedure finishes. Which action should you use?

choices.text: Copy the complete common procedure into each runbook.
choices.explanation: The procedure cannot be maintained as a common definition.

choices.text: Write the name of the common runbook in the procedure description field.
choices.explanation: A description field does not execute an action.

choices.text: Use aws:executeAutomation to specify the runbook name and the target input.
choices.explanation: This invokes the common definition and allows the caller to handle the internal execution result.

choices.text: Only record the target input in CloudWatch Logs.
choices.explanation: This does not specify that another runbook should be started.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: You can run another runbook from SSM Automation.
learning.concept: Manage the common procedure and the caller-specific input independently.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Clean up an empty retained resource only after an initial failure
prompt: If the initial CloudFormation creation fails, you want to clean up a newly created, empty S3 bucket. After the stack is created successfully and begins being used, you want the bucket to remain even if the stack is deleted. Which attribute should you use?

choices.text: Set DeletionPolicy to Delete.
choices.explanation: The bucket would be deleted not only during the initial attempt but also when the stack is deleted after deployment.

choices.text: Specify only UpdateReplacePolicy.
choices.explanation: This controls replacement during updates and does not determine the policy for ordinary stack deletion.

choices.text: Set DeletionPolicy to Retain.
choices.explanation: The empty bucket would also be retained during rollback of the initial creation.

choices.text: Set RetainExceptOnCreate for the bucket's DeletionPolicy.
choices.explanation: The bucket can be deleted during rollback of the initial create operation and retained otherwise.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: RetainExceptOnCreate distinguishes rollback of the initial creation from later deletion.
learning.concept: It expresses both the cleanup requirement for an initially empty resource and the data-protection requirement after the resource is in use.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Test the synthesized template configuration before deployment
prompt: A CDK-created S3 bucket must retain its encryption configuration in the synthesized template after a library update. The team wants CI to guarantee this without creating real AWS resources. What should be used to inspect the default configuration?

choices.text: Assume the bucket is encrypted when deployment succeeds.
choices.explanation: This does not independently verify that the required property is present.

choices.text: Add Encrypted to the stack name.
choices.explanation: The name does not guarantee encryption for the synthesized resource.

choices.text: Use Template.fromStack and hasResourceProperties to inspect the encryption configuration for the target bucket.
choices.explanation: This verifies before deployment that the synthesized result contains the required configuration.

choices.text: Compare only the production stack outputs with those from the previous run.
choices.explanation: This does not inspect the current template, which has not been deployed.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: CDK assertions can test a synthesized CloudFormation template.
learning.concept: You can compare declared properties during testing without retrieving values from a live environment.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Reuse VPC lookup results from the same version during synthesis
prompt: A CDK stack looks up the target environment's VPC during synthesis. The team wants another developer or CI to synthesize the template from the same lookup result and review the diff whenever the lookup value is updated. What should be managed?

choices.text: Version-control cdk.context.json together with the project.
choices.explanation: This shares the environment lookup values at the same version and makes updates traceable.

choices.text: Delete the context file and synthesize every time.
choices.explanation: Collaborators may not use the same lookup result.

choices.text: Use only cdk.out to add a new tag to the VPC.
choices.explanation: This is not a way to manage lookup-result reproducibility.

choices.text: Store an arbitrary developer's credentials in Git.
choices.explanation: Credentials are not needed to manage the lookup cache, and storing them exposes secrets.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: CDK caches environment lookup results in the CDK context.
learning.concept: Update the cache when an intentional change is made so that the old and new values can be reviewed in code.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Preserve existing custom values after updating an add-on
prompt: An EKS managed add-on is being updated to a compatible version. The operator wants to preserve, where possible, settings changed on the Kubernetes side and verify the outcome of the update through the API. Which combination should be used? Select two.

choices.text: Call UpdateAddon with OVERWRITE specified for resolveConflicts.
choices.explanation: This may restore conflicting changes to the EKS default values.

choices.text: Write only the new add-on version in a Kubernetes manifest and do not check the EKS update status.
choices.explanation: This cannot determine the result of the update managed by EKS.

choices.text: Treat the update as successful when the initial UpdateAddon response returns an update ID.
choices.explanation: The update ID is a reference for an asynchronous operation and does not represent its final state.

choices.text: Call UpdateAddon with PRESERVE specified for resolveConflicts.
choices.explanation: This updates the add-on with a policy of preserving existing conflicting settings.

choices.text: Use the update ID from the update response and call DescribeUpdate to check the final state and any errors.
choices.explanation: This verifies the result of the asynchronous operation after the update API accepts the request.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: When updating an existing add-on, you can choose conflict resolution that preserves custom values.
learning.concept: Preserving existing values and replacing them with EKS default values produce different results.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Apply rotated environment variables to a running service
prompt: ECS injects Secrets Manager secrets into task environment variables when a task starts. After rotation, processes in already running tasks still use the old value. What should be done to apply the new value while retaining the reference in the existing task definition?

choices.text: Add the update date to the tags of the running tasks.
choices.explanation: Updating tags does not reload the process startup configuration.

choices.text: Review the current version in the Secrets Manager console and treat the environment variables as updated.
choices.explanation: Changing the value does not reinject it into running tasks.

choices.text: Force a new deployment of the service and verify the behavior of the replacement tasks.
choices.explanation: New tasks can retrieve the latest value at startup.

choices.text: Change the value to plaintext and store it in the source code.
choices.explanation: This removes the secret reference and increases exposure of the secret value.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Injection into environment variables occurs when a task starts.
learning.concept: Rotation after injection does not automatically update a running process.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Separate image-pull permissions from application permissions
prompt: A new ECS task stops before pulling its image from ECR. The network and registry policies have been verified, and only the role used by ECS for pulling the image lacks the required permissions. Do not change the application's permissions after the container starts. Where should you configure the permissions?

choices.text: Add permissions for the target ECR repository only to the application's task role.
choices.explanation: The role is not used for the image pull before the application starts.

choices.text: Grant the task execution role used by the task definition permission to pull the target ECR image.
choices.explanation: This permits the pre-start image pull without changing the application's role.

choices.text: Only make the ECR tag immutable.
choices.explanation: Preventing metadata changes does not add read permissions.

choices.text: Increase the service's desired task count.
choices.explanation: This may increase the number of tasks that stop before startup with the same permission error.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Separate the task execution role used by the ECS agent from the task role used by the application inside the container.
learning.concept: Pulling an image before startup requires IAM permissions on the execution side.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Connect private Fargate to the image sources
prompt: Use the corresponding Fargate tasks in subnets without internet connectivity. The image is in ECR in the same Region. The execution role and all network permissions can be prepared. What should you configure for the image-pull path? Select two.

choices.text: Configure interface endpoints for the ECR API and Docker registry.
choices.explanation: This provides private paths to the API and registry.

choices.text: Provide an S3 gateway endpoint associated with the subnet's route table.
choices.explanation: This allows the image layers stored in S3 to be retrieved.

choices.text: Increase the task's memory limit.
choices.explanation: This does not make the image sources reachable over the network.

choices.text: Create only a Secrets Manager endpoint.
choices.explanation: This does not provide paths to ECR and S3.

choices.text: Create only a CloudWatch Logs endpoint.
choices.explanation: Logs may be delivered, but the image-pull path remains incomplete.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: In addition to ECR API and registry access, the actual image layers are retrieved from S3.
learning.concept: Configure access to each communication destination and associate the required endpoint with the subnet.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Restrict product inputs for one portfolio only
prompt: In AWS Service Catalog, one product is included in multiple portfolios. In only one portfolio, restrict the sizes that users can select to approved values. The launch role is already configured. What should you add?

choices.text: Only specify an IAM role in a launch constraint.
choices.explanation: This manages the role to use but does not define permitted parameter values.

choices.text: Only list the permitted sizes in the product description.
choices.explanation: A description cannot reject invalid parameter values.

choices.text: Set a template constraint on the product in the target portfolio.
choices.explanation: This applies input constraints based on where the same product is distributed.

choices.text: Remove the product from all portfolios.
choices.explanation: This would also prevent approved configurations from being provisioned.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A template constraint limits the values that can be specified when a product is provisioned.
learning.concept: Separate delegation of execution permissions from restriction of input values.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Pass Only the Fields Required by an Existing Target
prompt: You want to extract only the instance ID and state from an EventBridge EC2 state-change event and match the JSON format expected by an existing target. The event selection criteria are already configured. Which feature should you use?

choices.text: Increase only the target's retry count.
choices.explanation: This would only resend input that does not match.

choices.text: Use the name of the target state as the event bus name.
choices.explanation: Changing a name does not change the JSON structure.

choices.text: Configure the required fields and output template in an input transformer.
choices.explanation: This can pass an object that matches the existing input format.

choices.text: Only add fields to the matching conditions in the event pattern.
choices.explanation: This determines whether an event matches; it does not transform the input sent to the target.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: An input transformer extracts variables from an event and constructs the output.
learning.concept: Separate the process that selects events from the process that controls the format delivered to the target.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Bringing manually configured scaling into IaC
prompt: You manage a provisioned DynamoDB table with CloudFormation. You want to declare in code the minimum and maximum write capacity and the target utilization that were adjusted in the console. Specifying only the table's initial write capacity is not sufficient. Which settings are required?

choices.text: Make the target write capacity a ScalableTarget and configure target tracking with a ScalingPolicy.
choices.explanation: This continuously adjusts DynamoDB capacity within the declared range.

choices.text: Add one DynamoDB index.
choices.explanation: This does not change the target table's scaling range or target value.

choices.text: Change only the table's initial WriteCapacityUnits and assume that the same value will be tracked at runtime.
choices.explanation: This defines neither utilization-based adjustment nor a policy.

choices.text: Set the stack's DeletionPolicy to Retain.
choices.explanation: This controls handling during deletion and is not used for automatic adjustment during operation.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: The Application Auto Scaling target and policy can be declared separately.
learning.concept: Configure the adjustment range and conditions for ongoing operation separately from the initial provisioned capacity.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Keeping unavailable operational values unchanged
prompt: You are updating a CloudFormation stack and changing only some parameters. You want to use the current values of the other parameters as they are, without retrieving them into the deployment script. Which parameter setting should you use?

choices.text: Explicitly specify an empty string for the saved parameters.
choices.explanation: This does not specify reuse of the actual values.

choices.text: Restore all values to the template's default values.
choices.explanation: This may discard operational values configured after stack creation.

choices.text: Specify only UsePreviousTemplate.
choices.explanation: This selects the template but does not retain existing values for the specified parameters.

choices.text: Enable UsePreviousValue for the parameters whose existing values should be retained, and provide no new values.
choices.explanation: This lets the deployment use the operational settings without returning the values to the caller.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: During an update, the existing value of the same parameter can be reused without specifying a new value.
learning.concept: Selecting a template and supplying parameter values are separate settings.

category: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
examDomain: デプロイ・プロビジョニングと自動化
title: Start Host Management Across Multiple Accounts with a Common Configuration
prompt: An operations team is introducing EC2 Systems Manager management across multiple accounts in Organizations. The team wants to select the organizational scope and Regions for the initial setup and reduce manual work in each account. Which method should it use?

choices.text: Deploy the Quick Setup host management configuration to the target organizational scope and Regions.
choices.explanation: It can deploy a common configuration to the specified accounts and Regions.

choices.text: Only standardize the EC2 naming convention.
choices.explanation: This does not deploy the host management configuration.

choices.text: Have an operator sign in to each individual EC2 instance and configure it using their own procedure.
choices.explanation: This does not provide common configuration deployment or reduce manual work.

choices.text: Place the configuration only in one Region of a central account.
choices.explanation: This does not configure distribution to the other accounts in scope.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Systems Manager Quick Setup host management lets you select the deployment targets.
learning.concept: Distinguish common configuration during initial setup from individual commands after deployment.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Using unused permissions as candidates for periodic review
prompt: You want to reduce old permissions on a long-running IAM role. You will review historical usage and, rather than immediately deleting actions with no observed use, check for seasonal processing and unexpected access paths. Which data should you use first?

choices.text: Assume that last access is always observable for every action and delete them all at once.
choices.explanation: This can remove necessary permissions without considering the inspection scope or observation period.

choices.text: Check only the IAM role's creation month and treat all recently created roles as unnecessary.
choices.explanation: Creation time and action usage are independent.

choices.text: Review the role's last accessed information and compare unused candidates with execution history and users.
choices.explanation: This provides a basis for narrowing the candidates while allowing you to assess the need for scheduled operations.

choices.text: Delete policies with the most statements first without reviewing their contents.
choices.explanation: Statement count does not reveal usage history or impact.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: IAM last accessed information can be used as an indicator of actual usage.
learning.concept: It does not guarantee that there is no usage outside the displayed scope or that no operation will be required in the future.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Restricting encryption key use to EBS through a specific Region
prompt: A role used to deploy EC2 requires KMS permissions to operate encrypted EBS volumes. Direct calls to the KMS API from the same role must not be allowed; KMS usage must be restricted to requests sent by EBS in the Tokyo Region on behalf of the role. Which condition applies?

choices.text: In the KMS statement that allows the target role, add a condition requiring kms:ViaService to match ec2.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com.
choices.explanation: A request made directly by the role does not satisfy the condition for the specified service path.

choices.text: Specify kms:GrantIsForAWSResource for all cryptographic operations on the key.
choices.explanation: This condition is used for grant operations for AWS resources; it does not specify the service through which all cryptographic operations must pass.

choices.text: Assign the alias EBS to the key used by the deployment role.
choices.explanation: An alias alone cannot control whether a call was forwarded by EBS.

choices.text: Add only a condition requiring aws:RequestedRegion to match ap-northeast-1.
choices.explanation: A direct KMS call by the role in the same Region could also satisfy this condition.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: kms:ViaService can restrict key use to requests made through the corresponding AWS service.
learning.concept: A policy can control both the principal using the key and the service that makes the request on the principal's behalf.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Providing both connection paths for a rotation function
prompt: A Secrets Manager rotation Lambda function is in a VPC without internet connectivity. It can already connect to the database, but rotation fails because it cannot reach the Secrets Manager API. IAM is already configured. How should this be resolved?

choices.text: Change the Lambda timeout using only the database security group.
choices.explanation: The database connection already works; the missing requirement is a network path to the API.

choices.text: Disable Secrets Manager rotation permanently.
choices.explanation: This would not preserve the requirement to rotate credentials periodically.

choices.text: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Secrets Manager and verify name resolution and the HTTPS connection.
choices.explanation: This allows the Lambda function to reach the service API privately.

choices.text: Add only KMS permissions to the Lambda function and retry the request.
choices.explanation: IAM is already configured, and this does not restore API connectivity.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A rotation function in a VPC must be able to connect privately to Secrets Manager.
learning.concept: Connectivity to the database alone does not guarantee connectivity to the service that stores the credentials.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Using additional key protection for management-session traffic
prompt: Operations are performed through a standard Session Manager shell. In addition to the default communication protection, the organization wants to protect session data with a specified customer managed KMS key. This must be configured separately from encryption of the log destination. What should be changed?

choices.text: Include the key alias in the IAM group name.
choices.explanation: The group name is not used to encrypt sessions.

choices.text: Enable only EC2 disk encryption.
choices.explanation: Data at rest on disk and data transmitted in a Session Manager session are separate concerns.

choices.text: Enable KMS encryption in the Session Manager settings and configure the target key and required permissions.
choices.explanation: This applies additional protection using the specified key to session data.

choices.text: Change only the CloudWatch Logs retention period.
choices.explanation: The retention period does not affect protection of data during an interactive session.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Session Manager can be configured to use KMS encryption for session data.
learning.concept: Encryption for logs at rest must be distinguished from the setting that protects data during a session.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Checking compliance before creating actual resources
prompt: A department using the applicable AWS Config rule wants to evaluate the configuration of resources planned for deployment before creating them in production. This must be a separate procedure from evaluating existing resources, and CI will decide whether deployment is allowed. Which evaluation mode should be used?

choices.text: Use proactive evaluation of the applicable rule to evaluate the configuration of the planned resources.
choices.explanation: This allows compliance to be checked before the actual resources are created.

choices.text: Use only detective evaluation, create the resources in production, and delete them after the results are available.
choices.explanation: This is not evaluation before creation.

choices.text: Specify compliant in the CloudFormation stack name.
choices.explanation: A name does not guarantee the rule's evaluation result.

choices.text: Use a Config aggregator to view only the previous state of existing resources.
choices.explanation: This does not evaluate a new planned configuration.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Proactive evaluation can assess a planned configuration without creating the resources.
learning.concept: Using the evaluation result to control deployment must be configured separately.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Managing trust for internal-only TLS
prompt: Service names used internally are not used with the public PKI. You need to issue certificates for multiple internal servers from an organizational certificate authority trusted only by managed clients. What should you configure? Select two.

choices.text: Disable certificate-chain validation entirely on managed clients.
choices.explanation: This would not preserve the requirement to trust only the organization.

choices.text: Distribute the CA private key to all clients.
choices.explanation: Clients do not need the private key for trust, and distributing it would compromise the issuer.

choices.text: Distribute the required CA certificates to the trust stores of managed clients.
choices.explanation: This allows clients to validate the certificate chains of internal servers.

choices.text: Use the corresponding AWS Private CA to issue certificates for the internal servers.
choices.explanation: This provides organizational certificates from a managed certificate authority.

choices.text: Share a certificate for the CloudFront standard domain with the internal NLB.
choices.explanation: This would not provide a certificate with the required issuance and trust scope.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Align the private certificate issuer with the trust configuration of the clients that use the certificates.
learning.concept: Public certificate chains and private trust chains have different distribution requirements.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Limit shared-key use to an operational log group
prompt: Encrypt a new CloudWatch Logs log group with a customer managed KMS key. The key policy must allow Logs to use the key while limiting that use to this log group. Which combination of specifications should you use? Select two.

choices.text: Add the log group ARN as an IAM principal.
choices.explanation: The log group ARN identifies a resource; it is not a principal that calls KMS.

choices.text: Set the log group ARN as the value of the condition key kms:ViaService.
choices.explanation: Use the service name with ViaService; restrict the log group ARN through the encryption context instead.

choices.text: Allow the CloudWatch Logs service principal for the log group’s Region in the key-usage statement.
choices.explanation: CloudWatch Logs is the principal authorized by this statement.

choices.text: Allow cryptographic operations for the CloudWatch Logs service in the Region without conditions.
choices.explanation: Even in the correct Region, this would not restrict use to the target log group.

choices.text: Use the target log group ARN as a condition value for kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn.
choices.explanation: This requires Logs requests to contain the encryption context for the specified log group.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Logs can pass the log group ARN to KMS in the encryption context.
learning.concept: Combine permission for the service principal with a condition that limits the resource.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Audit the original operator across multiple role assumptions
prompt: In an organization, operators sign in to a central role and then switch to an operations role in another account. You need to carry the original operator’s identifier through the chain and correlate it in CloudTrail. Do not use a name that each operator can arbitrarily change. Which feature should you use?

choices.text: Have each operator connect using the same RoleSessionName.
choices.explanation: A shared name cannot distinguish the operators.

choices.text: Set SourceIdentity at the trusted authentication source and grant the required sts:SetSourceIdentity permission in each role’s trust policy.
choices.explanation: The original identifier can then be verified in audit records after the role switches.

choices.text: Use a fixed tag on the destination role as the operator’s value.
choices.explanation: This does not distinguish individual sessions using the same role.

choices.text: Overwrite the resource name of each role with the name of the last person to connect.
choices.explanation: Multiple people can use the role concurrently, so this does not associate individual API operations with an operator.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: STS SourceIdentity is carried through a role chain.
learning.concept: Set a trusted identifier at the original authentication point and verify it in CloudTrail.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Handle a role used by an AWS service itself
prompt: A newly enabled AWS service feature indicates that it requires a service-linked role. The operations team wants the service to run with the access permissions defined by the service and does not want to attach all permissions preemptively to a custom role. What should they do?

choices.text: Attach all permissions for operating the service to the users’ personal IAM users.
choices.explanation: This does not provide the execution role required by the AWS service and over-privileges the users.

choices.text: Use permission to create the service-linked role specified by the supported service, and enable the feature with the service-defined role.
choices.explanation: This uses access managed for that service without creating a custom role with broad permissions.

choices.text: Create only an empty role whose name contains service.
choices.explanation: A name alone does not create a service-linked role.

choices.text: Open every role’s trust policy so that anyone can assume it.
choices.explanation: This removes the restricted trust requirement for the service.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A service-linked role is directly associated with a specific service and has permissions defined by that service.
learning.concept: Permission to create the required service-linked role is separate from granting general permissions to users.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Investigating traffic that does not reach stateful inspection
prompt: You want to apply stateful rules to traffic passing through the AWS Network Firewall inspection path. During an investigation, you find that the traffic exits inspection as soon as it matches a stateless Pass action. What should you configure?

choices.text: Change the applicable stateless action to Forward to stateful rules.
choices.explanation: The traffic will proceed to evaluation by the stateful rules.

choices.text: Add stateful to the firewall description name.
choices.explanation: This does not cause the traffic to be passed to the stateful engine.

choices.text: Set all stateless actions to Drop.
choices.explanation: This blocks the traffic and does not meet the requirement to inspect and then allow it.

choices.text: Keep the stateless Pass action and only increase the number of stateful rules.
choices.explanation: The traffic will not proceed to stateful evaluation.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A stateless Pass action and forwarding to the stateful engine are separate processing behaviors.
learning.concept: Explicitly forward traffic from the first matching path to stateful inspection.

category: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
examDomain: セキュリティとコンプライアンス
title: Managing writes from another department under bucket-owner control
prompt: In a shared S3 bucket, an uploader from another account writes objects. You want the bucket owner to manage all objects without relying on ACL grants, with access controlled by the receiving account's policy. Older clients explicitly specify individual ACLs. Which combination should you choose? Select two.

choices.text: Use Object writer and continue operating with the uploader owning the objects.
choices.explanation: Ownership is not consolidated under the bucket owner.

choices.text: Enable only default S3 encryption.
choices.explanation: Encryption settings do not change ownership or ACL evaluation.

choices.text: Require public-read ACLs for every upload.
choices.explanation: This is incompatible with disabling ACLs, and public access is unnecessary.

choices.text: Use S3 Object Ownership with Bucket owner enforced.
choices.explanation: Object management can be consolidated under the bucket owner without using ACLs.

choices.text: Remove arbitrary ACL specifications from the old clients and allow writes through a bucket policy.
choices.explanation: Writes of new objects can be moved under policy-based control.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: With Bucket owner enforced, the bucket owner owns the objects and ACLs are disabled.
learning.concept: Older clients that send arbitrary ACL specifications must be updated.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信

title: Reusing a central DNS forwarding rule in departmental VPCs
prompt: A central account manages a Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint and a forwarding rule for on-premises destinations. You want VPCs in another account's departments to use the same rule while managing the forwarding destinations centrally in one place. Which combination should you choose? Select two.

choices.text: Share the applicable Resolver rule from the central account by using AWS RAM.
choices.explanation: The forwarding rule can be made available for use by another account.

choices.text: Create only a rule with the same name in the department account and do not configure forwarding destinations.
choices.explanation: A name does not share the actual forwarding configuration.

choices.text: Register all names in the department VPCs in public DNS.
choices.explanation: This does not reuse the central rule and would expose internal names publicly.

choices.text: Configure the central endpoint IP addresses as the NS records of the department's public zone.
choices.explanation: This does not share selective forwarding rules within the department VPC.

choices.text: In the department account, associate the shared rule with the target VPC.
choices.explanation: The forwarding rule will apply to queries from the target VPC.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Resolver forwarding rules can be shared with other accounts by using AWS RAM.
learning.concept: Sharing a rule and associating it with the VPC that uses it are separate operations.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Complete the Parent’s Signing Information for Validation
prompt: DNSSEC signing is enabled for a public Route 53 hosted zone, and the key-signing key is ACTIVE. You need a resolver that performs DNSSEC validation to validate the chain from the parent zone to the child zone’s signing public key. What should be registered on the parent side?

choices.text: Add the child zone’s web server IP address to the parent zone as an A record.
choices.explanation: An A record does not convey trust for the signing key.

choices.text: Only reduce the TTL of the child zone.
choices.explanation: The cache duration for lookups does not create a chain of trust.

choices.text: Register the DS information provided by Route 53 in the parent zone’s public DNS or through the domain-management procedure.
choices.explanation: This establishes the DNSSEC trust relationship from the parent to the child.

choices.text: Add another self-referencing NS record to the child zone.
choices.explanation: This does not configure the child’s signing-key digest to be conveyed to the parent.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: The DS record in the parent zone links the parent’s trust to the child zone’s signatures.
learning.concept: Enabling signing for the child zone alone does not create a trust chain from the parent.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Enable private zone names in a VPC
prompt: The Route 53 private hosted zone is already associated with the target VPC, and each EC2 instance uses AmazonProvidedDNS. A separate administrative change disabled the VPC setting related to DNS hostnames. Which state should be verified to use private DNS?

choices.text: Shorten the TTL of every private record.
choices.explanation: This does not enable private DNS within the VPC.

choices.text: Add an Internet Gateway to the VPC and forward the private zone information to an external resolver.
choices.explanation: This does not change the required DNS attributes for the target VPC.

choices.text: Assign a public IP address to every EC2 instance.
choices.explanation: Private hosted zones do not require this, and it does not change the DNS attributes.

choices.text: Enable both enableDnsSupport and enableDnsHostnames.
choices.explanation: This provides the DNS attributes required for the VPC's private hosted zone.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: VPC DNS attributes are prerequisites when using managed DNS resolution.
learning.concept: Even an associated zone cannot provide the expected name resolution if the required VPC attributes are not enabled.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Add only a static suffix to viewer requests
prompt: For a viewer request to CloudFront, append index.html only to paths that end with a slash. No connection to an external service is needed, and the origin selection can remain unchanged. Which feature should be used to perform this simple rewrite during the viewer-request phase?

choices.text: Change only the cache TTL and assume that a new value is also placed in the URI.
choices.explanation: The cache lifetime does not change the request path.

choices.text: Associate a CloudFront Function with viewer-request and adjust the URI only for the specified paths.
choices.explanation: This transforms the applicable requests without changing the origin implementation.

choices.text: Add index.html to the common name of the distribution's certificate.
choices.explanation: TLS name validation is unrelated to URI transformation.

choices.text: Use only a response headers policy to transform the URI received by the origin.
choices.explanation: Response headers do not change the path that has already been sent.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: CloudFront Functions can modify a URI during a viewer request.
learning.concept: Distinguish lightweight string transformations from processing that requires network communication.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Make one private file available for a specified period
prompt: A single file is distributed to purchasers through CloudFront. An application can verify each user's entitlement, and access should be allowed only for a short specified period. Which feature controls this with one URL without using cookies?

choices.text: Make users wait until the cache expires and do not configure entitlement for individual users.
choices.explanation: Cache retention and the period for which access is allowed are different concerns.

choices.text: Shorten the standard CloudFront URL and manage the expiration using only the shorter name.
choices.explanation: URL length or naming does not validate an access expiration.

choices.text: Use a trusted key group with a restricted behavior to issue a time-limited CloudFront signed URL.
choices.explanation: The permission to access the file can be evaluated using the signature and expiration time.

choices.text: Make the entire S3 bucket public and change only the CloudFront origin domain.
choices.explanation: This does not impose a time-limited access restriction on each user.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A signed URL can grant time-limited access to a file.
learning.concept: Configure the key that is trusted for the signature and the controls on the distribution side.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Immediately reflect an update distributed at the same URL
prompt: Maintenance information at a fixed URL behind CloudFront has been updated. The cache for other files should be preserved, and only that URL should be updated quickly during a long TTL. The viewer-facing URL cannot be changed. What should be done?

choices.text: Issue a CloudFront invalidation for the path of the updated file.
choices.explanation: The next retrieval can obtain the updated content from the origin without targeting other paths.

choices.text: Lower the maximum TTL uniformly for all paths.
choices.explanation: This also changes the caching policy for files outside the target.

choices.text: Only place the new file on the origin.
choices.explanation: An edge location with a long TTL may continue returning the previous content.

choices.text: Require viewers to use a different path containing a hash.
choices.explanation: This does not satisfy the requirement to keep the same fixed URL.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: A CloudFront invalidation can remove cached content for specified paths.
learning.concept: Versioning is also useful when frequently updated content can use a different URL.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Distinguishing pre-relay source and interface values
prompt: A network operations team is analyzing VPC Flow Logs for traffic passing through a relay ENI. In addition to the standard source information, the team wants the original source address of the packet included in the logs. The packet payload itself must not be stored. Which method should be used?

choices.text: Record the creation API for the same ENI in CloudTrail and use it to determine the packet's original source.
choices.explanation: An audit record of resource creation does not include the packet source.

choices.text: Add pkt-srcaddr to the custom log format.
choices.explanation: The packet-level source can be obtained even for traffic passing through a relay.

choices.text: Treat the start field as the source address.
choices.explanation: This field is the time when measurement of the flow began.

choices.text: Display only the action for the same flow.
choices.explanation: It indicates whether the traffic was accepted or rejected, but does not include the original source address.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: VPC Flow Logs provide additional fields that include packet-level source and destination addresses.
learning.concept: For records of traffic passing through a relay interface, distinguish the meanings of srcaddr and pkt-srcaddr.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Allowing outbound IPv6 connections and replies while blocking inbound initiation
prompt: IPv6-only workers are running. They need IPv6 connections to the internet initiated by the workers and the corresponding replies, but new connections must not be initiated from outside to the workers. Address translation is not required. Which route should be used?

choices.text: Point the subnet's IPv6 default route to an egress-only internet gateway.
choices.explanation: This allows outbound IPv6 connections while preventing new connections from being initiated from outside.

choices.text: Point IPv4 0.0.0.0/0 to an Internet Gateway.
choices.explanation: This route does not match IPv6 destinations.

choices.text: Assign an EIP as the address of the IPv6 worker.
choices.explanation: An EIP is a public IPv4 address.

choices.text: Use an S3 gateway endpoint for all IPv6 destinations.
choices.explanation: It applies to S3 destinations and is not a general internet route.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: An egress-only internet gateway can be used for outbound-only IPv6 connectivity.
learning.concept: Replies to connections initiated by the workers are handled differently from new connections initiated from outside.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Propagating VPN-learned routes to the required TGW route table
prompt: A VPN under a Transit Gateway advertises on-premises CIDRs through BGP. The routes do not appear in the TGW route table associated with the application VPC attachment, and adding static routes is undesirable. What should be checked?

choices.text: Give the VPN and application VPC attachments the same name.
choices.explanation: Matching names do not determine where routes are propagated.

choices.text: Disable BGP and wait for the learned CIDRs to appear in the route table.
choices.explanation: This would remove the dynamic routes being received and would not meet the operational requirement.

choices.text: Enable route propagation from the VPN attachment to the TGW route table associated with the application VPC attachment.
choices.explanation: The BGP-learned routes are added to the table used for route lookup from the application VPC.

choices.text: Add NAT routes for internet-bound traffic.
choices.explanation: This does not add the VPN-learned routes to the TGW route table.

source.label: AWS公式ドキュメント

learning.reason: Routes learned from an attachment can be propagated to a specific TGW route table.
learning.concept: The route table associated with the source attachment and the destination for learned-route propagation are different concepts.

category: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
examDomain: ネットワークとコンテンツ配信
title: Selecting only corporate destinations over VPN while preserving ordinary client internet access
prompt: A Client VPN connection to the company's CIDRs is established, but ordinary internet traffic is also entering the VPN. The company routes should be distributed to client devices, while their normal internet traffic should continue using the devices' existing connections. The endpoint does not need to distribute a default route. What should be configured?

choices.text: Delete all authorization rules for the corporate CIDRs.
choices.explanation: This would not separate ordinary traffic and would also deny access to corporate resources.

choices.text: Keep full tunneling enabled and direct the default route to the VPN.
choices.explanation: Ordinary traffic would also pass through the VPN.

choices.text: Enable Split-tunnel and keep the required corporate destinations in the Client VPN route table.
choices.explanation: Only traffic destined for corporate resources can then be routed through the VPN.

choices.text: Change the device's VPN name to split.
choices.explanation: Changing the name does not change the routes that are distributed.
